verdict.rationale: A published uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions for a SaaS product like Notion, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an SLA, uptime commitments, or a status page. The webhook and API items are about a different capability and do not count here.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
